youtube.title: How Isaac Newton's genius was almost ruined by fish 🐟 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Isaac Newton knew how planets move… and lost the paper. 🪐🐟

Edmond Halley got him to write Principia, then the Royal Society said: sorry, we spent the money on fish.

Worst budget decision in science history? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1684–1687: Newton told Halley orbits were ellipses but couldn't find his calculation. The Royal Society had blown its budget on Willughby's "History of Fishes", so Halley paid to print Principia, and the Society paid him in unsold fish books.

#isaacnewton #edmondhalley #physics #historyofscience #science #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts

hook.say: Halley asked Newton how planets move. Newton knew the answer. He lost it.
